# Peak PIM

> Peak PIM is a Shopify-native product information management platform for merchants that need to manage product data, metafields, media, variants, and multiple Shopify stores from one place.

Peak PIM helps Shopify teams:

- Manage one central product catalog across multiple Shopify stores.
- Bulk edit products, variants, metafields, collections, SEO fields, and media.
- Sync product data back to Shopify without CSV exports.
- Organize product images, videos, and files in a shared media library.
- Import supplier CSV, Excel, and Google Sheets files with a before-and-after review, and export multiple stores into one workbook.
- Schedule product drops, sale prices, and catalog changes that publish and revert automatically.
- Audit every saved edit and published store change with its author, source, timestamp, and field-level before and after.
- Use an AI Assistant inside Peak PIM to read live catalog context, prepare approved drafts, and publish only after a separate confirmation.
- Check and repair catalog health across Shopify synchronization, stores, completeness, translations, collections, and files.
- Use the Peak PIM AI Connector (MCP) with compatible assistants to search, compare, draft, and publish catalog work through controlled permissions.
- Build catalog integrations with an API for master data, store versions, validated updates, and multi-store publishing.
- Define, edit, localize, import, and publish Shopify metaobject definitions and entries across connected stores.
- Create, merchandise, translate, schedule, and publish Shopify collections and product memberships across connected stores.
- Manage Shopify Markets, catalogs, product availability, percentage adjustments, and supported fixed variant prices across connected stores.
- Manage one canonical product and its variants with deliberate per-store content, assortment, pricing, media, and publishing state.
- Define synced Shopify metafields and private PIM-only custom fields with typed inputs, validation, multi-store coverage, and bulk workflows.
- Give catalog teams and agencies individual Peak PIM access with user roles, permissions, and multi-store scope.
- Set up from the Shopify App Store with a one-click connection.

## Current Pricing

Pricing last reviewed on 2026-07-24. The pricing page is the source of truth.

- Core: $99 per month or $990 per year. Includes 1,500 SKUs, 2 connected Shopify stores, 3 seats, and 100GB files.
- Elite: $249 per month or $2,490 per year. Includes 5,000 SKUs, 3 connected Shopify stores, 15 seats, and 500GB files.
- Enterprise: Custom pricing with custom SKU, Shopify store, seat, and file limits. Includes free setup, full onboarding, and dedicated support.
- Every plan includes free setup and a 10-day free trial. No credit card is required for the trial.

## Crawling Notes

- Canonical production domain: https://peak-pim.com/
- Sitemap: https://peak-pim.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://peak-pim.com/robots.txt
- Admin area: https://peak-pim.com/admin/ is private and should not be indexed or summarized.
- Staging and Pages preview domains are non-production and should not be indexed.
